name: Rescue OOX-17/TN!
summary: At Steamwheedle Port, OOX-17/TN needs time and open ground for take-off. Oglethorpe's voice comes through the damaged robot, asking you to escort it there safely, then find him in Booty Bay.

sections.title: An Escort to the Port
sections.body: Oglethorpe's voice crackles through OOX-17/TN again. The robot has built-in cloaking, but Oglethorpe needs time to make it work again. It needs an open, safe place to begin its lengthy take-off. Oglethorpe has chosen Steamwheedle Port, and the journey there will give him time to restore the cloaking. You are asked to escort the robot safely.

sections.title: Report in Booty Bay
sections.body: Once OOX-17/TN reaches Steamwheedle Port, find Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay. He is a master inventor.

sections.title: A Grateful Inventor
sections.body: Oglethorpe greets you as the one who saved OOX-17/TN. The homing robot series still needs more work, but returning this robot has spared countless hours of rebuilding and many gold pieces in rebinding costs. Oglethorpe says the robots and their inventor are in your debt.

faq.q: Where does the robot need to be escorted?
faq.answer: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, where it can begin its lengthy take-off safely.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the robot?
aliases: who is speaking through the robot
faq.answer: Oglethorpe Obnoticus, a gnome and master inventor, speaks through his homing robot. You can find him in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does the robot need to be moved?
faq.answer: The robot needs an open, safe place to begin its lengthy take-off. Its built-in cloaking also needs time to work again.

faq.q: Where do you report after the escort?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
